OpenNo coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.See evidence · L01

BlockedDeposit / ring / coating / failure / maintenance early warningCannot be tested until plant event records existSee evidence · F15

OpenThe historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.See evidence · L12

How to read this

There is no plant ground truthNo coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.Source: L01

There is no plant ground truth

No coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.

Times have no timezoneThe historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.Source: L12

Times have no timezone

The historian export carries no timezone. The API serves naive timestamps unchanged and requires plant annotations to use the same naive plant-local clock.
